picture.alt: A sunny club fair on a university campus: tents in blue, orange, green and red, students walking between them, trees and brick buildings behind. Two young men with backpacks stand in front. On the left, under a blue tent, an acoustic guitar stands on a black stand next to a table with a red cloth; nobody is holding it. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt and black trousers stands near it with his hands in his pockets, leaning forward and looking right, at the next table. On the right, at a table with a blue cloth, a young man with wavy brown shoulder-length hair, a yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt, dark green trousers and a white backpack holds a calligraphy brush up in his right hand and looks down at a sheet of white paper held by a wooden weight, his left hand resting on the table; a pot of brushes and an ink stone stand on the table. Far behind him on the right, people in black clothes do kung fu on a red carpet.

picture.alt: A bright children's room with big windows, green plants, shelves of books and toys and a picture of a yellow flower on the wall. A young man with black hair, a green jacket over a red striped T-shirt sits at a table between two small boys, smiling, and holds out a blue crayon to the boy on the right, who reaches for it. The boy on the left has curly brown hair and an orange T-shirt and draws with a red crayon on a picture with a yellow sun and green trees. The boy on the right has short black hair and a dark blue T-shirt, holds a green crayon in his other hand and has drawn a house, trees and a sun. A box of crayons and a cup of crayons stand on the table. Nobody is reading. In the back, a woman with reddish-brown hair and a green apron works at a table.

text.traditional:
時間：11月4日到12月23日，每個星期六早上9點到12點
地點：學校旁邊的醫院
工作：陪病人掛號、檢查，幫病人處理住院、出院等事情，或是到病房關心、照顧病人。
注意：第一次參加的社員，只能陪病人掛號跟檢查；服務過三次的社員，才能去病房。想參加的社員，請在10月27日以前寫電子郵件給社團。
text.simplified:
时间：11月4日到12月23日，每个星期六早上9点到12点
地点：学校旁边的医院
工作：陪病人挂号、检查，帮病人处理住院、出院等事情，或是到病房关心、照顾病人。
注意：第一次参加的社员，只能陪病人挂号跟检查；服务过三次的社员，才能去病房。想参加的社员，请在10月27日以前写电子邮件给社团。
text.pinyin:
Shíjiān: 11 yuè 4 rì dào 12 yuè 23 rì, měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng 9 diǎn dào 12 diǎn
Dìdiǎn: Xuéxiào pángbiān de yīyuàn
Gōngzuò: Péi bìngrén guàhào, jiǎnchá, bāng bìngrén chǔlǐ zhùyuàn, chūyuàn děng shìqíng, huòshì dào bìngfáng guānxīn, zhàogù bìngrén.
Zhùyì: Dì yī cì cānjiā de shèyuán, zhǐ néng péi bìngrén guàhào gēn jiǎnchá; fúwù guo sān cì de shèyuán, cái néng qù bìngfáng. Xiǎng cānjiā de shèyuán, qǐng zài 10 yuè 27 rì yǐqián xiě diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi shètuán.
text.english:
Time: November 4 to December 23, every Saturday, 9 a.m. to 12 noon
Place: the hospital next to the school
Work: going with patients to register and for check-ups, helping them with admission, discharge and so on, or visiting and caring for patients on the wards.
Note: members coming for the first time may only go with patients to register and for check-ups; members who have served three times may go to the wards. Members who want to take part, please email the club before October 27.

passage.traditional: 我從小就想學鋼琴，所以開學第一天，我{1}去參加了鋼琴社。社團的教室不大，門旁邊{2}著一架鋼琴，大家一進門就看得見。社員都得用{3}一架練習，一天只能用半個小時。老師說我的{4}還不夠好，要多練習以前學過、現在快忘了的歌。所以我每天先把那些歌{5}一遍，再學新的。雖然時間不長，一個學期後，我的進步不小。

Shètuán de jiàoshì bú dà, mén pángbiān bǎi zhe yí jià gāngqín, dàjiā yí jìn mén jiù kàn de jiàn. Shèyuán dōu děi yòng tóng yí jià liànxí, yì tiān zhǐ néng yòng bàn ge xiǎoshí. Lǎoshī shuō wǒ de jìqiǎo hái bú gòu hǎo, yào duō liànxí yǐqián xué guo, xiànzài kuài wàng le de gē. Suǒyǐ wǒ měi tiān xiān bǎ nàxiē gē fùxí yí biàn, zài xué xīn de. Suīrán shíjiān bù cháng, yí ge xuéqí hòu, wǒ de jìnbù bù xiǎo.
passage.english: I’ve wanted to learn piano since I was little, so I joined the piano club on the first day of term. The club room is small. A piano is set out by the door, where everyone can see it as soon as they come in. The members share it, so we can only play for half an hour each day. The teacher said my technique needed work and told me to play more of the songs I used to know but am starting to forget. So each day I go over those songs first, then practise new ones. Even with so little time, I made quite a bit of progress after a term.

choices.english: each other
originally
right away
often

questions.why: Wanting it since childhood, on the very first day of term she went at once: 立刻. 互相 needs two people doing it to each other, 本來 needs a later change of plan, and 經常 does not fit one first day.

choices.english: to set out
to put away
to stand
to hang

questions.why: Everyone sees the piano as they come in and members play it daily, so it stands set out by the door: 擺著. 收著 means put away out of sight; 站著 is for people standing, not for things; a piano is not hung.

choices.english: every
each
which
same

questions.why: There is only one piano in the room, so everyone shares it: 同一架鋼琴, and that is why each person gets only half an hour. 每一架 and 各 would mean many pianos.

skill
gains
future

questions.why: What is "not good enough yet" and fixed by daily practice is her playing skill: 技巧. Gains (收穫), meaning (意義) and the future (未來) are not what a teacher corrects before practice.

choices.english: to choose

passage.english: My younger sister has been shy since childhood. When she started university, she joined the kung fu club to learn to protect herself. In the practice room, some kung fu clothes hang on the back of the door; everyone takes them down to wear before practice. The female student who teaches my sister lives on the second floor and my sister lives on the third. They live in the same dorm building and can find one another by taking the stairs. Once at practice, the members tried a move several times and still couldn’t get it, but she got it right the first time. My sister was impressed. After a term of practice she got much braver. text.traditional: 我念高中的時候，父母極重視我的成績，常說只要成績好，就會有美好的未來。所以上大學以前，我除了念書，什麼活動都沒參加過。大一的時候，室友帶我去參加吉他社。一開始我學得很慢，也不好意思問別人，後來發現社員都會互相幫忙，學得快的會教學得慢的。期末的時候，我們在校園裡表演，前面坐滿了同學。從這次表演中，我發現自己成長了不少：我變得比以前勇敢，不只會念書，也能把別的事做好。我覺得這是上大學以後最大的收穫。
text.simplified: 我念高中的时候，父母极重视我的成绩，常说只要成绩好，就会有美好的未来。所以上大学以前，我除了念书，什么活动都没参加过。大一的时候，室友带我去参加吉他社。一开始我学得很慢，也不好意思问别人，后来发现社员都会互相帮忙，学得快的会教学得慢的。期末的时候，我们在校园里表演，前面坐满了同学。从这次表演中，我发现自己成长了不少：我变得比以前勇敢，不只会念书，也能把别的事做好。我觉得这是上大学以后最大的收获。
text.pinyin: Wǒ niàn gāozhōng de shíhòu, fùmǔ jí zhòngshì wǒ de chéngjī, cháng shuō zhǐyào chéngjī hǎo, jiù huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái. Suǒyǐ shàng dàxué yǐqián, wǒ chúle niànshū, shénme huódòng dōu méi cānjiā guo. Dà yī de shíhòu, shìyǒu dài wǒ qù cānjiā jítā shè. Yì kāishǐ wǒ xué de hěn màn, yě bù hǎoyìsi wèn biérén, hòulái fāxiàn shèyuán dōu huì hùxiāng bāngmáng, xué de kuài de huì jiāo xué de màn de. Qímò de shíhòu, wǒmen zài xiàoyuán lǐ biǎoyǎn, qiánmiàn zuò mǎn le tóngxué. Cóng zhè cì biǎoyǎn zhōng, wǒ fāxiàn zìjǐ chéngzhǎng le bù shǎo: wǒ biàn de bǐ yǐqián yǒnggǎn, bù zhǐ huì niànshū, yě néng bǎ bié de shì zuò hǎo. Wǒ juéde zhè shì shàng dàxué yǐhòu zuì dà de shōuhuò.
text.english: When I was in high school, my parents put enormous weight on my grades and often said that as long as my grades were good, I would have a wonderful future. So before university I took part in no activities at all, only studying. In my first year, my roommate took me to join the guitar club. At first I learnt slowly and was too shy to ask anyone, but then I found that the members all help one another: those who learn fast teach those who learn slowly. At the end of term we performed on campus, with classmates filling the seats in front. From this performance I found that I had grown a lot: I am braver than before, and I can do more than study: I can do other things well too. I think this is the biggest thing I have gained since starting university.

text.traditional: 小文是我在愛心服務社認識的朋友。他從小在育幼院長大，那時候常有大學生來陪孩子念書、畫畫。他說，跟大哥哥、大姐姐一起念書、畫畫的時間很美好，也讓他知道有人關心他。現在他自己上了大學，每個月都會回育幼院兩次，教孩子做功課，也教他們互相幫忙。我知道小文也極重視成績，所以問他，花這麼多時間服務，不會影響成績嗎？他說：「成績當然重要，可是我從服務中發現，這些孩子很像小時候的我。能陪他們一起成長，對我來說，是最大的收穫，也比什麼都有意義。」
text.simplified: 小文是我在爱心服务社认识的朋友。他从小在育幼院长大，那时候常有大学生来陪孩子念书、画画。他说，跟大哥哥、大姐姐一起念书、画画的时间很美好，也让他知道有人关心他。现在他自己上了大学，每个月都会回育幼院两次，教孩子做功课，也教他们互相帮忙。我知道小文也极重视成绩，所以问他，花这么多时间服务，不会影响成绩吗？他说：「成绩当然重要，可是我从服务中发现，这些孩子很像小时候的我。能陪他们一起成长，对我来说，是最大的收获，也比什么都有意义。」
text.pinyin: Xiǎowén shì wǒ zài àixīn fúwù shè rènshì de péngyǒu. Tā cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, nà shíhòu cháng yǒu dàxuéshēng lái péi háizi niànshū, huàhuà. Tā shuō, gēn dà gēge, dà jiějie yìqǐ niànshū, huàhuà de shíjiān hěn měihǎo, yě ràng tā zhīdào yǒu rén guānxīn tā. Xiànzài tā zìjǐ shàng le dàxué, měi ge yuè dōu huì huí yùyòuyuàn liǎng cì, jiāo háizi zuò gōngkè, yě jiāo tāmen hùxiāng bāngmáng. Wǒ zhīdào Xiǎowén yě jí zhòngshì chéngjī, suǒyǐ wèn tā, huā zhème duō shíjiān fúwù, bú huì yǐngxiǎng chéngjī ma? Tā shuō: "Chéngjī dāngrán zhòngyào, kěshì wǒ cóng fúwù zhōng fāxiàn, zhèxiē háizi hěn xiàng xiǎoshíhou de wǒ. Néng péi tāmen yìqǐ chéngzhǎng, duì wǒ lái shuō, shì zuì dà de shōuhuò, yě bǐ shénme dōu yǒu yìyì."
text.english: Xiaowen is a friend I met in the volunteer service club. He grew up in a children's home, and back then university students often came to help the children study and draw. He says the days he spent reading and drawing with those older students were wonderful and showed him that someone cared about him. Now he is at university himself, and twice a month he goes back to the children's home to help the children with homework and to teach them to help one another. I know Xiaowen also cares a great deal about grades, so I asked him whether spending so much time on service would not hurt his grades. He said: "Grades matter, of course, but volunteering has shown me how much these children are like I was at their age. Being able to grow up alongside them is the biggest thing I gain, and it means more to me than anything."

text.traditional: 上個月我從宿舍搬出來，在學校附近租了一間公寓。房租每個月七千塊，包括水費，可是電費得自己付。房東就住在樓下，人很好，還替我裝了一台新的洗衣機，說有什麼問題，隨時可以找他。這個社區很安全，門口二十四小時都有人，不認識的人得先說要找誰，才能進去。搬家那天下大雨，還好室友開車來幫我，要不然我一個人得搬好幾次。現在我對住的地方很滿意，只要有空，就請朋友來家裡吃飯。
text.simplified: 上个月我从宿舍搬出来，在学校附近租了一间公寓。房租每个月七千块，包括水费，可是电费得自己付。房东就住在楼下，人很好，还替我装了一台新的洗衣机，说有什么问题，随时可以找他。这个社区很安全，门口二十四小时都有人，不认识的人得先说要找谁，才能进去。搬家那天下大雨，还好室友开车来帮我，要不然我一个人得搬好几次。现在我对住的地方很满意，只要有空，就请朋友来家里吃饭。

Fángdōng jiù zhù zài lóuxià, rén hěn hǎo, hái tì wǒ zhuāng le yì tái xīn de xǐyījī, shuō yǒu shénme wèntí, suíshí kěyǐ zhǎo tā. Zhège shèqū hěn ānquán, ménkǒu èrshísì xiǎoshí dōu yǒu rén, bú rènshì de rén děi xiān shuō yào zhǎo shéi, cái néng jìnqù. Bānjiā nà tiān xià dà yǔ, háihǎo shìyǒu kāichē lái bāng wǒ, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén děi bān hǎo jǐ cì. Xiànzài wǒ duì zhù de dìfāng hěn mǎnyì, zhǐyào yǒu kòng, jiù qǐng péngyǒu lái jiā lǐ chīfàn.
text.english: Last month I moved out of the dorm and rented a flat near school. The rent is seven thousand a month, water included, but I pay the electricity myself. The landlord lives just downstairs and is very kind; he even had a new washing machine put in for me, and said I could come to him any time with a problem. The neighbourhood is very safe: there is someone at the entrance twenty-four hours a day, and unfamiliar visitors must first say who they are visiting before they can go in. It poured on moving day; luckily my roommate drove over to help, otherwise I would have had to make several trips on my own. Now I am very happy living here, and whenever I am free I invite friends over for a meal.

text.traditional: 我爸爸去年因為身體不好，住院了兩個星期。出院以後，醫生建議他改善飲食，少油少鹽，也別再喝可樂了。醫生說，不改的話，很快又得回醫院。爸爸從小就愛吃炸的東西，一開始覺得青菜一點味道都沒有，難吃死了。後來，我們每天吃完晚飯就陪他去公園散步，他越走越遠，體重也減了五公斤。現在爸爸不但精神好多了，而且常說：「對我這個年紀的人來說，身體健康比什麼都重要。」
text.simplified: 我爸爸去年因为身体不好，住院了两个星期。出院以后，医生建议他改善饮食，少油少盐，也别再喝可乐了。医生说，不改的话，很快又得回医院。爸爸从小就爱吃炸的东西，一开始觉得青菜一点味道都没有，难吃死了。后来，我们每天吃完晚饭就陪他去公园散步，他越走越远，体重也减了五公斤。现在爸爸不但精神好多了，而且常说：「对我这个年纪的人来说，身体健康比什么都重要。」
text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba qùnián yīnwèi shēntǐ bù hǎo, zhùyuàn le liǎng ge xīngqí. Chūyuàn yǐhòu, yīshēng jiànyì tā gǎishàn yǐnshí, shǎo yóu shǎo yán, yě bié zài hē kělè le. Yīshēng shuō, bù gǎi de huà, hěn kuài yòu děi huí yīyuàn. Bàba cóngxiǎo jiù ài chī zhá de dōngxi, yì kāishǐ juéde qīngcài yìdiǎn wèidào dōu méiyǒu, nánchī sǐ le. Hòulái, wǒmen měi tiān chī wán wǎnfàn jiù péi tā qù gōngyuán sànbù, tā yuè zǒu yuè yuǎn, tǐzhòng yě jiǎn le wǔ gōngjīn. Xiànzài bàba búdàn jīngshén hǎo duō le, érqiě cháng shuō: "Duì wǒ zhège niánjì de rén lái shuō, shēntǐ jiànkāng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào."
text.english: Last year my father was in hospital for two weeks because of poor health. After he came out, the doctor advised him to improve his diet: less oil, less salt, and no more cola. The doctor said that if he did not change, he would soon be back in hospital. Dad has loved fried food since he was little, and at first he found vegetables had no taste at all and were awful. Later we took him for a walk in the park every day after dinner; he walked further and further, and lost five kilos too. Now Dad not only has much more energy, he often says: "For someone my age, good health matters more than anything."
